Keynote speakers
4 of 68 featured
AO
Amara Okafor
Principal Designer · Loomwork Studio · Lagos

Amara has spent a decade pulling identity systems apart and reassembling them with fewer moving parts. Her keynote argues for design systems that age well — and what to retire when they don't.

The Patient Vector: Designing for Year Five, Not Launch

Tue · 09:30 · Hall A

Design Systems
RT
Rin Takahashi
Independent Type Designer · Kyoto

Type designer behind Kalsai and Pavor Series. Rin will trace the path from a single ink stroke to a 12-weight variable family, including every detour she'd recommend.

A Quiet Argument for Slower Type

Wed · 14:00 · Atrium Stage

Type & Identity
DM
Diego Marin
Staff Engineer · MeadNight · Mexico City

Diego writes about long-form frontend infrastructure with surprising affection. Expect a talk about caching, observability, and the joy of deleting code you wrote two years ago.

Boring on Purpose: A Frontend Survival Guide

Thu · 11:00 · Studio Hall

Frontend
SL
Saoirse Lynch
Founder · Field Notes Co · Dublin

Saoirse runs a four-person studio with a sliding-scale pricing model and a deep bench of weird projects. Her closing talk is half pep, half ledger.

The Small Studio Math Nobody Teaches

Fri · 16:00 · Hall A

Indie Practice
